overclaims.abstract: Further, the results also indicate that the content and methods of teaching differ and that teachers did not experience digital models as one single idea but as an amalgam of multiple ideas.
overclaims.body: The synthesis shows that teaching digital models is not centered on only one objective, and teaching content and methods may differ
overclaims.why: The body says content and methods only 'may differ', while the abstract states flatly that they differ.
